en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large, elegant early‑20th‑century residential or institutional complex. On the left is a three‑storey villa-like building with steep, tiled roofs, dormers, and an oculus window; on the right, a much larger multi‑wing block with similar steep roofs, dormers, and many windows with flower boxes. The style combines late‑historicist and early Art Nouveau / Jugendstil elements. There is a landscaped garden and trees between the buildings, a decorative entrance gate with steps at the street, and a quiet road in the foreground where a single pedestrian stands. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
